# Junior Data Scientist
Quillmetrics · Full-time

What you'll do

- Own product analytics for our onboarding funnel.
- Run experiments with the growth team.

Requirements

- 0-2 years of experience; strong projects count.
- SQL.
- Python.
- Experimentation and A/B testing.

Nice to have

- Experience with Amplitude or Mixpanel.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Quillmetrics is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
